from rdkit import Chem
from collections import Counter
s='CC(C)(C)C(=O)NC1=CN=CC=C1C(O)C1=CC=C(F)C=C1Cl'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
counts=Counter(a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms())
h=sum(a.GetTotalNumHs() for a in m.GetAtoms())
counts['H']=h
order=['C','H','N','O','F','Cl']
formula=''.join(e+(str(counts[e]) if counts[e]!=1 else '') for e in order if counts[e])
print('atom_counts', dict(counts))
print('formula', formula)
